mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the front side was worthwhile because it turned the frame into a whale and began giving the construction its shape.

leastWorthwhile.text: Turning to each side was clear but somewhat repetitive in the text interface.

surprise.text: The first side panel changed the construction's name from Frame to Whale, even before the tail and fins were attached.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; each fitting or turn followed the current construction goal.

continue.text: I would be curious to see what the completed whale does, though the straightforward text-only fittings themselves offered limited decisions.
